item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["7b7c990d61bcf26e26ef","5e651bfc3bc6e03d9957"],"operation":"Check xmlXIncludeGetLastError after XInclude processing.","condition":"An injected allocation failure is reported during processing.","capability":"Preserve XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY in the XInclude context error state.","consequence":"The existing harness assertion aborts if the getter returns a different error.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same existing allocation failure assertion and context error state."},{"member_ids":["00980152d1a462c3b661","4030c0b8bee247c61c87"],"operation":"Route XInclude and included XML parser errors.","condition":"A qualifying processing error occurs with a handler registered through xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler.","capability":"Forward errors to the XInclude context's structured error handler.","consequence":"The registered handler does not receive the error.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same per-context handler routing for XInclude and included XML parsing."},{"member_ids":["5026c265dd1663b72432"],"operation":"Route XPointer evaluation errors.","condition":"XPointer evaluation reports a qualifying error with an XInclude context handler registered.","capability":"Forward the handler to the XPath context used for XPointer evaluation.","consequence":"The registered handler does not receive the XPointer error.","equivalence_reason":"This targets the XPointer evaluation route, which is distinct from XInclude and included XML parser error routing."},{"member_ids":["af66585f6de9ca12458e"],"operation":"Evaluate a local-document XPointer during XInclude processing.","condition":"Streaming mode is enabled.","capability":"Reject local-document XPointer evaluation in streaming mode.","consequence":"The streaming-mode restriction is not enforced.","equivalence_reason":"This concerns a streaming-mode restriction, distinct from error-handler routing and the allocation failure assertion."}]}
